evidence.why: Exact table declaration, initializers, and pointer-returning accessor.

facts.rationale: Preserves the exact source-level type while removing an unsupported assertion that the section contains both the table and all literals.
facts.value: The source declares an initialized char* vi_animation_table[26] with 26 fighter-specific ViWait archive filename string literals. The accessor returns an indexed filename pointer. This source evidence does not establish which compiled sections contain the table or its string literals.

evidence.why: Ordered selectors, masks, dispatches, and final camera call.
Outer mask selects callback passes; gxlink_prios selects link lists.
Activation guard and subsequent caller-selected dispatch.

facts.rationale: Corrects the confusion between render-pass mask 7 and GX link index 7 using the canonical dispatcher.
facts.value: The caller supplies a camera-associated HSD_GObj. Camera selector values 2, 1, and 0 flow to Camera_800310A0; gxlink_prios receives masks 9, 8, and 8 before successive HSD_GObj_80390ED0 calls. Each call receives render-pass mask 7, enabling callback pass indices 0, 1, and 2 over the link lists selected by gxlink_prios: links 0 and 3 for mask 9, and link 3 for mask 8. Finally the same GObj and flag 1 flow to Camera_800313E0. In vi_RunCamera, successful camera activation precedes this helper, and a caller-selected link-mask dispatch follows it.

facts.rationale: Preserves the established rendering purpose while correcting the mistaken GX-link-7 description.
facts.value: Runs the shared three-phase rendering core for visual-scene camera callbacks. It selects camera values 2, 1, and 0 in sequence, assigns GX-link selection masks 9, 8, and 8, and dispatches render callback passes 0, 1, and 2 for each phase using pass mask 7. It then calls Camera_800313E0 with the camera GObj and flag 1.

evidence.why: Guarded sequence without a latch or input mutation.
Trigger accessor only returns the field.

facts.rationale: Removes an unconditional once-per-press guarantee that neither the helper nor its read-only input accessor implements.
facts.value: Each invocation reads the selected controller's processed trigger mask. If Start is absent, no cleanup or scene-command write occurs. If Start is present, the helper performs its ordered audio and all-port rumble cleanup and writes scene command 1. It has no local timer, persistent latch, or trigger consumption: repeated invocations against the same Start-bearing trigger state repeat the sequence. Normal per-frame use is supplied by visual-scene callbacks.
